messages:
alex: heads-up — multiple customers opened tickets about SDK client timeouts starting ~08:45 UTC. getting a flurry of 504s at the gateway. seeing higher p95 latency as well. creating triage thread.
priya: saw that too. initial signal shows client sdk retries spiking, lease tokens held longer. linking support ticket IDs: #C-7891, #C-7893.
mike: can we get a quick repro from one of the affected customers? ask for a curl or SDK snippet + headers.
sara: customer sent this minimal repro (node sdk):
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/sdk');
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.generate({ model: 'rwd-2-small', prompt: 'hello' });
```
They get a timeout after 10s consistently.
alex: interesting — our default client-side timeout is 10s. are we seeing backend token stalls or gateway queuing?
ops-bot: [ALERT] spike in gateway request queue length (+400%) at 2023-10-12T08:45:12Z. autoscaler did not bring up new workers due to scaling lock.
jordan: scaling lock? that's the new cooldown policy we shipped last week. could be interaction with bursty client retries.
priya: logs from edge show many inflight connections from the SDK's HTTP/1.1 keepalive, connection reuse looks okay, but backend bouncer returns 502 for some shard pools. snippet: `proxy->runtime request failed: downstream reset`
mike: can we correlate with batcher metrics? maybe the batcher hit queue cap and rejected early.
sara: batcher p99 queueing jumped to 180ms then started dropping requests with 503. stack: ingress -> gateway -> batcher -> serving runtime.
alex: immediate mitigation: bump client-side timeout recommended? but that's customer-facing. internal mitigation steps: 1) lower gateway concurrency per connection to reduce head-of-line blocking, 2) temporarily relax scaling cooldown. can we implement 2) now?
jordan: I can flip the cooldown to 30s from 2m for the next 15min. doing it now.
ops-bot: [ACTION] cooldown-adjust applied by jordan at 2023-10-12T08:52:01Z.
priya: after cooldown flip, autoscaler launched two new worker groups into eu-west-1. queue length dropped ~65% within 90s. customers report fewer timeouts.
lia: customer C-7891 confirms reduced 504s after 08:54. but still occasional 5xx for longer prompts.
mike: followup: we need a thorough repro that triggers the path: client SDK retry pattern -> gateway queue growth -> scaling lock. ask customer to run a looped script to replicate. include header X-RW-Request-ID.
sara: sent repro template to customers with instructions: include `--header "x-rw-client-retries: 3"` and attach tcpdump if possible.
alex: root cause hypothesis: new cooldown policy + sudden client retry storms caused autoscaler to under-react while batcher queue overflowed, leading to gateway returning 5xx/504. also some serving shards reported a KV cache stall.
priya: KV cache stall logs show long GC pauses on one shard around same window. that increased per-request latency and made scaling worse. separate thread exists but likely related.
jordan: next steps (short):
- keep cooldown relaxed for 30m and monitor (owner: jordan)
- roll back the cooldown change permanently for the rollout window (owner: eng-runtime)
- patch gateway to emit better queue/backpressure metrics (owner: eng-sre)
- add SDK guidance to backoff jitter/retry caps (owner: devex)
- request customer repro artifacts (owner: support)
mike: add an immediate bandaid in the runtime: if batcher queue > 75% and scaling is locked, return 429 rather than 5xx to avoid confusing customers. (owner: eng-runtime)
lia: agree — clearer error semantics helps triage and customer UX.
alex: followup action items for postmortem:
- timeline of events (include autoscaler signals, gateway queue length, kv GC, customer retries) (owner: oncall)
- patch cooldown policy + create canary guard (owner: eng-platform)
- SDK release note recommending user-side timeout defaults and retry jitter (owner: devex)
- create alert that joins kv cache stalls with autoscaler inaction (owner: eng-ml)
- customer communications: support to send status and mitigation note (owner: support)
ops-bot: [NOTE] page created: PM-1234 incident page for client SDK timeout spike.
priya: quick ask — do we have logs correlating individual request IDs across gateway and runtime? that'll help attribute to specific serving shard.
sara: yes we do; I've pulled two example request IDs and attached to ticket. example: `req_20231012_8a7c` trace shows gateway->batcher->runtime latency exploded at KV cache GC boundary.
jordan: temp config reverted to normal at 09:20 after autoscaler and runtime patches rolled out. will keep monitoring.
mike: please include a timeline entry for the cooldown flip and revert and the minutes of improved metrics.
lia: support will send an update to impacted customers summarizing: what happened, what we did, what we're changing, and ETA for permanent fixes.
alex: good job team. we'll run full postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC. attach owners to tasks and track in PM-1234.
priya: any other immediate followups?
sara: engineering note: add a small patch to batcher to emit `reject_reason` for dropped requests (helpful for support).
mike: logging item noted. closing triage thread for now, will reopen if spike returns. :thumbsup:
